our_inference: On the differentiable non-degenerate domain where analytic inverse exactly undoes cubic map, ordinary total Jacobian is identity. A custom backward gate is distinct from that Jacobian. No claim at degenerate points or for assumed hardware confinement.
decision: Not a complement-only ordinary-weight anti-merging candidate. Gradient-free AGA/replacement bypass the mechanism; do not add modules, train head or assume non-removability.
